evaluation_standard.costs: frozen 18 bps roundtrip clause, identical for both arms (evaluator crypto-evaluation-v5-corrected: first-touch TOUCH, +/-1.5R / +/-2.5R, 30-day cap)
evaluation_standard.dependence: one cluster per asset (coinId); same-run dependence is NOT merged into clusters under v3 — it is disclosed via a mandatory per-run pair breakdown in every comparison report (v3 amendment of the v2 transitive coinId-OR-run components, which measured 1 cluster over the whole accrued population; doc 47)
evaluation_standard.inference: mean paired difference; cluster bootstrap over coinId clusters; 10,000 resamples; 90% percentile interval; ambiguous/unknown/non-evaluable/immature counted, never pooled
evaluation_standard.insufficient_evidence: INCONCLUSIVE — never promotes, never extends the window silently
evaluation_standard.paired_return: net R per arm; net R = gross R - 0.0018 x entry / |entry - invalidation| (frozen 18 bps clause converted to R units at the position's own risk distance); non-taking arm = 0
evaluation_standard.promotion: separate explicit decision by Logan after a review; nothing in this registration promotes anything
evaluation_standard.retuning: forbidden; any rule-text change voids this registration and requires a new one
evaluation_standard.review_checkpoints: 30 matured divergences in a class AND 8 weeks from registration (2026-12-16) — reporting points with uncertainty, not adoption triggers
evaluation_standard.review_deadline: 12 weeks from registration (2027-01-13) — conclude or retire/redesign explicitly; no silent extension
